snippet.title: Knight of the Lions - Release Trailer
snippet.description:
On November 27, help a teenage girl named Vita collect pieces of the world that has shattered around her, get her feet back on the ground and realize that being a knight is not about wearing a suit of armor.

The game will be available on Steam.

Wishlist it here: https://store.steampowered.com/app/1711790/Knight_of_the_Lions/

Might & Magic by Alexander Nakarada (CreatorChords) | https://creatorchords.com
